# Attempt 7: both slices have their own RED and GREEN, the regression is next

The return at record 95 amended slice 2 to name harness/tests/test_report.py
(solution 96, route 97). The first tdd advance of attempt 7 was refused: GREEN 87
from attempt 6 could not be cited, because no accepted tdd record says which slice
it proved, so the tree was compared whole. Both slices were replayed in attempt 7
by restoring the pre-slice code for their non-test files, recording the RED, and
restoring the committed code for the GREEN. No source changed:

- Slice 1 (sonnet, seen-implementer): RED 102 (failures=3, errors=30), GREEN 103.
- Slice 2 (haiku, seen-implementer): RED 104 (the two F3 failures), GREEN 105.

Regression 100 and coverage 101 came before 102, so they no longer satisfy
green <= regression. Next session: run the regression (python3 -m unittest
discover -s harness/tests, about 390 s), set "regression" in
.harness-drafts/SEEN-116-tdd.json to its record number (the slices there already
cite 102/103 and 104/105), record coverage again if the gate asks for it, then
advance tdd. Before the review triage: set status: review and tick the criteria
in the ticket file (the Outcome for attempts 6 and 7 is already written, commit
4740e2a).
